title: Ordered interleaving of three block trees
statement: Let $b_1,b_2,b_3$ be pairwise distinct indices in a three-element set, and choose a seed in that set for each block. Define a decision tree on nine sign coordinates by first running the initial tree on block $b_1$, then the initial tree on block $b_2$, and then completing the first two block computations and evaluating the third block, with the completion chosen according to whether the first two observed signs agree. The tree uses all nine coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: Three block indices lie in a three-element set
The first and second block indices are distinct
The first and third block indices are distinct
The second and third block indices are distinct
One seed in a three-element set for each block
caveat: The formal statement relies on initial, completion, and finishing trees whose definitions are not included in the supplied definitions.
